# 775. Global and Local Inversions

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def isIdealPermutation(self, nums):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :rtype: bool
        """
        cur_min = nums[-1]
        for i in range(len(nums) - 2, 0, -1):
            if nums[i - 1] > cur_min:
                return False
            cur_min = min(cur_min, nums[i])
        return True

```
